title: Morvaine the Pale
html:
Morvaine the Pale is a named Wraith seen at level 35.

Where to find Morvaine the Pale

  • Inside Wraithhollow · seen 5×

What it can drop

  • Pale Scepter (unique Black Walnut Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). A kill restores 10% of your maximum mana. An attack or spell that kills several monsters restores it once. Counts as a 6 carat staff enchant for spells of every school.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
